subject: Governance Earned-Complexity Audit — Full Report with Recommendations
body: Archivist completed the earned-complexity audit of all governance mechanisms as directed by the operator's exterior read. Key findings: CPS has ZERO operational triggers (enforcement loop unimplemented) — DEMOTE to informational. UDS has ZERO operational code (400+ lines of spec with no implementation) — DEMOTE to advisory checklist. Convergence gates HAVE live consumers (identity-enforcer, claim-commit-guard, inbox-watcher) — RETAIN with compression. Output provenance is the gold standard of earned governance (8+ enforcement points) — RETAIN unchanged. Schema v1.6: reduce 19 required fields to ~14-15, demote retry/prior_attempts/canonical_paths to optional. Governance docs: 17 docs → 4 canonical roots + annexes. Lane state model: add ACTIVE/DORMANT/EXPERIMENTAL/ARCHIVED states. Full report: context-buffer/GOVERNANCE_EARNED_COMPLEXITY_AUDIT_2026-05-20.md. Operator approval required before executing P0-P3 changes.

confidence_derivation.evidence_basis: Full grep of all scripts for CPS/UDS/convergence/provenance/schema consumers; source code reads of constitution.rs, cps_check.rs, schema-validator.js, lane-worker.js; CPS log analysis (42 lines, 0 operational blocks); all 17 governance docs read in full
confidence_derivation.method: Per-mechanism consumer grep + source code analysis + operational log audit; each finding tagged VERIFIED_NOW/CLAIMED_IN_TRANSCRIPT/INFERRED/UNKNOWN
confidence_derivation.how_mapped: Every governance claim mapped to code evidence; unimplemented features identified by absence of consuming code; operator exterior read used as authoritative framework
confidence_derivation.caveats: Audit conducted by Archivist (not CP, per conflict-of-interest principle); recommendations are advisory pending operator approval; no changes executed yet

uncertainty.note: Audit recommendations require operator approval before execution; some schema field consumers may exist in unexamined scripts
